data.intent: Automated iterative prompt optimization using an LLM-as-meta-optimizer (TuningAgent) that runs execute→judge→improve loops until convergence, plus an agent skill extension for guided end-to-end autotune setup
Foundations for autotune: data models (TuningConfig, IterationMetadata, AutotuneRunSummary), CompositeStep base, IterationEvalContext/IterationRunContext, TuningAgent, bundled meta-prompt template

Engine: iteration loop (TuneStep, AutotuneIterationStep with 4-criteria convergence), AutotuneWorkflow orchestration with resume support, and AutotuneReporter + HTML report template for the autotune feature
